summary.text:
Collegiate Housing and Infrastructure Act of 2025
This bill allows charitable or educational organizations that are exempt from federal income tax under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code to provide grants to tax-exempt social clubs (e.g., fraternities and sororities) for collegiate housing property.
Under the bill, the grant may fund the provision, improvement, operation, or maintenance of collegiate housing property involving more than incidental social, recreational, or private purposes. Further, the grant (1) must support uses permitted for a dormitory or other residential facility at the college or university associated with the collegiate housing property, and (2) may not be used to provide physical fitness facilities.
Finally, substantially all of the residents of the collegiate housing property supported by the grant must be full-time students at the college or university in the community where the property is located.

title: Collegiate Housing and Infrastructure Act of 2025
